title: A remotely operated airboat for metal-free, ultraclean water sampling for trace elements in lentic waterbodies: from design and fabrication to operation in the field☆
author: Noernberg, Bujaczek, et al.

steps.title: Adjust Loiter Radius to 2 m
steps.instruction: Using the Ground Control Station software, change the loiter radius from the initial 5 m to 2 m.

steps.title: Verify Sonar Display on Herelink
steps.instruction: Check that the sonar image is correctly displayed on the Herelink remote control; if not, modify the remote’s software until the display functions properly.

steps.title: Check Wind Conditions Within Safety Limits
steps.instruction: Measure wind speed before launch; proceed only if wind speed is between 1.4 km/h and 10.8 km/h (e.g., do not launch when wind reaches 31.3 km/h, which exceeds the safety guideline).

steps.title: Perform Pre‑operational Safety Checks
steps.instruction: At the Home location on the shoreline of Star Lake, conduct all pre‑operational safety checks as listed in Table S2 and confirm that each check is passed.

steps.title: Deploy Airboat and Navigate to Site
steps.instruction: Launch the SWAMP airboat from Home and cruise approximately 58 m to Site 1, using the loiter function with the 2 m radius as needed.

steps.title: Collect Water Samples at Specified Depths
steps.instruction: At Site 1, lower acid‑cleaned transfer bottles to depths of 1.5 m, 3.0 m, and 4.5 m sequentially, release the weight to open the collector, and retrieve each water sample.

steps.title: Handle Collector Line Jam and Bottle Change
steps.instruction: If the water sample collector line becomes caught on the back of the boat and does not reel in properly, stop the operation, replace the bottle with a fresh acid‑cleaned bottle, fully reel in the line, and then resume sampling.

steps.title: Repeat Sampling Missions Three Times
steps.instruction: Perform the entire sampling sequence (steps 5‑7) for three separate missions, yielding three collections at each depth.

steps.title: Record Timing Data and Total Duration
steps.instruction: For each collection, record the duration in seconds; after completing the three missions, note that the total operational time was 1 hour 40 minutes.
